name: syncpad-workspace
description: SyncPad — Real-time collaborative workspace & code pad for students

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm run db:push --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
